findings.title: Project structure turns are not cumulative and reset after completion
findings.observed: After a completed Reader turn, the browser API returned spend.turns=1 and spend.structure_turns=0.
findings.source: proof_web/studios.py:804-818 at c0232ef initializes structure=0 and reads only the current Coordinator while status is reading or pursuing. Completed Coordinators and the Reader are omitted.
findings.scope: Confirmed Reader-only browser observation and source inspection. No completed multi-Theorem browser scenario was run.
findings.impact: The project budget panel omits structure spending after the Pursue ends and undercounts past structure work while the next Theorem runs. Total turn enforcement is unaffected.
